test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **

PROVOKE
solution: The correct answer is '**Enrage**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Provoke**' is '**Enrage**'. • **Provoke**: to cause a particular feeling or reaction. (विशेष भाव या प्रतिक्रिया उत्‍पन्‍न करना; उकसाना) • *Example: His remarks **provoked** both tears and laughter.* • **Enrage**: to make somebody very angry. [(किसी व्‍यक्ति को) बहुत ग़ुस्‍सा दिलाना, अत्‍यधिक क्रोधित कर देना] • *Example: His thoughtless behavior **enraged** us.* **Correct Answer:__** *enrage.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **gratify**: to give somebody pleasure and satisfaction. (प्रसन्‍नता और संतोष देना) • **placate**: to make somebody feel less angry about something. (किसी को शांत करना) • **hinder**: to make it more difficult for somebody/something to do something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कठिनाई पैदा करना, किसी के काम में बाधा डालना) 3a:Tb00, The erroneous part is** 'teacher were teaching'.**
